_howto: Approved entry-wall projects. To add one from a review email, copy an entry below and fill it in. Required: project, siteUrl, hackathon. Optional: builder, hackathonUrl, pitch, devpostUrl, codeUrl, videoUrl, tags (max 5), added (YYYY-MM-DD), featured (true pins it first), note (short badge text). Never add an email address here. Then rebuild and publish.
